purpose: Determine whether a new independently scored real-contract set can be run without reusing model-seen fixtures.

repository_inventory.source_named_classification: controlled, synthetic, previously used, or lacking an independent real-contract gold manifest

roles: one ordinary DOCX or DOCM with independently marked positive risks
one ordinary DOCX or text PDF with explicit no-risk controls
one text or scanned PDF to exercise page and region anchors
